violations.detail: .github/workflows/ci.yml is a governance file; a job may change it only when the accepted reading lists it as a deliverable and names it in an acceptance criterion

producer_report.summary: Scoring rules are versioned (v2), and the gate recomputes each score under the rules string it carries. A history guard recomputes historical scores with the working-tree scorer. It runs in xtask ci and in the CI workflow. The change is recorded in docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md. No file under records/ is modified. The one thing I could not confirm is the real-repository check over the 8 score files. This snapshot has no records/ and only one commit, so the check reports a single violation for that throwaway commit and nothing about scores. cargo test --locked passed. I did not rerun clippy or fmt in this send-back.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo run -p athena-cli -- check --history` (or the repository's equivalent) over the real repository reports no violation for the 8 existing score files, including records/jobs/2026-10/20261013-141005-hrdp/score.json. `git diff` shows no file under records/ modified. Run `git diff --stat` and the check.
criteria_check.evidence: git diff --stat lists only ci.yml, CHANGELOG.md, history.rs, jobs.rs, landing_tests.rs, athena-score lib.rs, decisions.md and xtask main.rs. No file under records/ is touched. The check could not be run over the real repository: this snapshot has no records/ and a one-commit history. Running it here gives 'checked 1 commits and 0 record files: 1 violation(s)', and that violation is the throwaway snapshot commit, not a score. The code makes old scores verify by recomputing each one under the rules string it carries (v1 scores under v1, with a bound-only cost not provisional). It is exercised by the gate tests and by the history guard tests, but the 8 real files were not exercised. The verifier or CI needs to run the check in the full repository.
